program:
PARAMS = {
    "Rf":    (150e3, 132e3, 200e3),
    "Cf":    (10e-15, 1e-15, 60e-15),
    "I1":    (26e-6, 15e-6, 32e-6),
    "gmid1": (17.0, 12.0, 22.0),
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),
    "gmp":   (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "kpb":   (0.3, 0.15, 0.5),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); vdd = 1.8
    Rf, Cf, I1 = p["Rf"], p["Cf"], p["I1"]
    Ipb = p["kpb"] * I1
    Lb = 1.0; gmb = 10.0

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.55)
    vout = m1.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vout)
    vout = m1.vgs
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=max(vdd - vout, 0.3))
    mpd = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], Ipb, vds=mp.vgs)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=0.75)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    mbp = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, Ipb, vds=max(vdd - mpd.vgs, 0.3))

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MBP", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbp)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("MP1", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "iin", "vout", Cf)

    # ---- exact 2-node small-signal model ----
    gm = m1.gm; go = m1.gds + mp.gds
    Ct = cpd + max(m1.cgg - m1.cgd, 0.0)
    Cft = Cf + m1.cgd
    Co = cl + m1.cdd + mp.cdd
    def zt(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        Y = 1 / Rf + s * Cft
        den = (go + s * Co + Y) * (s * Ct + Y) / (Y - gm) - Y
        return 1 / den
    def zd(f):  # vout per unit current injected at vout
        s = 2j * PI * f
        Y = 1 / Rf + s * Cft
        return 1 / ((gm - Y) * Y / (s * Ct + Y) + go + s * Co + Y)
    z0 = abs(zt(1e3))
    fs = np.logspace(5, 10, 2000)
    mag = np.array([abs(zt(f)) for f in fs])
    idx = np.where(mag < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3 = fs[idx[0]] if len(idx) else 1e10

    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    id2 = kT4 * 0.9 * (gm + mp.gm) * 2.0   # thermal + flicker allowance
    f = 1e6
    in2 = kT4 / Rf + id2 * abs(zd(f) / zt(f)) ** 2
    power = vdd * (iref + Ipb + I1)

    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(z0), "f3db": f3, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout, "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2)}
